# Processing Preview Fixtures

These fixtures pin the quick-preview block inside
`v600/gui/process_handlers.py:switch_to_image`.

`quick-preview-rgb16-resize.json` uses a synthetic uint16 RGB image large
enough to exercise OpenCV `INTER_AREA` resizing, the `gray < 240` content mask,
percentile stretch, OpenCV CLAHE, and JPEG quality 90 encoding. The arrays were
generated by the frozen Python path in the Nix development shell.
